definition: Two-letter code for the licence family.
format_rule: One of LP, LQ, LR, LX. Each code maps to exactly one folder_description.
known_issues: No published code list; meanings come only from folder_description.

definition: Label for the licence family (for example 'License - Personal Sales').
known_issues: Uses US spelling 'License'; the City's by-law and this project use 'Licence'.

definition: The licensed activity (for example 'Used Goods Dealer', 'Converted Residential Dwelling').
format_rule: Each activity belongs to exactly one licence family.
known_issues: Portal description says the City licenses 12 activities; the data holds more, including historical ones. Personal services (LQ) and residential (LR) have no licences issued after 2021. The April 2026 extract held 8 activities; November holds 18.

definition: Operating name of the licensee, when one is registered.
format_rule: Never blank. '(none)' means no trade name.
sensitivity_note: for personal services (LQ), a trade name may identify an individual (NEEDS EVIDENCE). Public for other families.
known_issues: '(none)' is a placeholder rather than a true blank, so missing names do not show up as missing. Not unique and cannot identify a business on its own.

definition: Civic address of the licensed premises (project working definition; no City definition published).
format_rule: Street number, street name, suffix. Blank only where withheld.
sensitivity_note: withheld by the City for rooming houses (LX); published for personal services (LQ), where it may be a home address (NEEDS EVIDENCE); public for business premises (LP, LR).
known_issues: Blank for every rooming house record, which looks like deliberate redaction, but no redaction policy is published (NEEDS EVIDENCE). Redaction is inconsistent across families. Street suffixes are not standardized (AVE, ST, Broadway, RD).

format_rule: Valid date. CSV export: 'YYYY Mon DD HH:MM:SS AM'. API: ISO 8601. Stored here as YYYY-MM-DD.
known_issues: Some records have an expiry date earlier than the issue date. Format differs between CSV export and API.

definition: Date the licence stops being valid.
format_rule: Valid date, on or after issue_date.
known_issues: Expiry before issue on some records (see issue_date). Basis of the 'not expired' test in the downtown funnel.

definition: Current lifecycle status of the licence.
format_rule: One of the observed status values.
known_issues: Meaning of the '(L)' suffix is not published (NEEDS EVIDENCE). Only the current status is kept, with no status history. In April 2026, 1,655 records said 'Issued' after their expiry date; in November, 1.

format_rule: Text code in the form D.DDD (for example 3.170). Must keep all three decimals.
known_issues: Published as a number, so trailing zeros can be lost: '3.17' instead of '3.170'. 398 rows in the April extract and 3 in November (CRESTVIEW appears as both 2.21 and 2.210).
One-to-one with neighbourhood_number except where the code lost its trailing zero.

format_rule: One of the City's ward names.
known_issues: POLO PARK appears under two ward names ('St James' and 'St James - Brooklands - Weston'), possibly a ward boundary or name change over time (NEEDS EVIDENCE). Not stated whether the ward is as of the licence date or today.

definition: City planning area. This project uses 'Downtown' here as its definition of downtown.
format_rule: One of the observed area names.
known_issues: Not stated whether the area is as of the licence date or today. 'Downtown' here may not match other downtown boundaries, such as the Downtown BIZ (NEEDS EVIDENCE).

definition: Map point for the address, as longitude and latitude.
sensitivity_note: same as address, since it is precise enough to locate a building.
known_issues: Blank wherever address is blank, plus some records that have an address but no point.
